delivery_note: UK delivery only, flat rate per order. Estimate: check Royal Mail prices for the real parcel size before the first print goes live.
rules: Only status "live" items are sold. A live item needs a price, a real photo (mockup false) and stock or made_to_order. Any item in category "toy" also needs compliance true and a compliance_ref (technical file reference) before it can be live. netlify/lib/prints.ts enforces this on the server and tests/prints.test.js checks this file.
